verses.en: I lifted up mine eyes again, and looked, and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.
verses.pt: Tornei a levantar os meus olhos, e olhei, e eis um homem que tinha na mão um cordel de medir.
verses.en_web: I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.
verses.en_bbe: And lifting up my eyes, I saw a man with a measuring-line in his hand.

verses.en: Then said I, Whither goest thou? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.
verses.pt: Então perguntei: Para onde vais tu? Respondeu-me ele: Para medir Jerusalém, a fim de ver qual é a sua largura e qual o seu comprimento.
verses.en_web: Then I asked, “Where are you going?” He said to me, “To measure Jerusalem, to see what is its width and what is its length.”
verses.en_bbe: And I said to him, Where are you going? And he said to me, To take the measure of Jerusalem, to see how wide and how long it is.

verses.en: And, behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him,
verses.pt: E eis que saiu o anjo que falava comigo, e outro anjo lhe saiu ao encontro,
verses.en_web: Behold, the angel who talked with me went out, and another angel went out to meet him,
verses.en_bbe: And the angel who was talking to me went out, and another angel went out, and, meeting him,

verses.en: And said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein:
verses.pt: e lhe disse: Corre, fala a este mancebo, dizendo: Jerusalém será habitada como as aldeias sem muros, por causa da multidão, nela, dos homens e dos animais.
verses.en_web: and said to him, “Run, speak to this young man, saying, ‘Jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls, because of the multitude of men and livestock in it.
verses.en_bbe: Said to him, Go quickly and say to this young man, Jerusalem will be an unwalled town, because of the great number of men and cattle in her.

verses.en: For I, saith the LORD, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.
verses.pt: Pois eu, diz o Senhor, lhe serei um muro de fogo em redor, e eu, no meio dela, lhe serei a glória.
verses.en_web: For I,’ says Yahweh, ‘will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the middle of her.
verses.en_bbe: For I, says the Lord, will be a wall of fire round about her, and I will be the glory inside her.

verses.en: Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the LORD: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: Ah, ah! fugi agora da terra do norte, diz o Senhor, porque vos espalhei como os quatro ventos do céu, diz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north,’ says Yahweh; ‘for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the sky,’ says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Ho, ho! go in flight from the land of the north, says the Lord: for I have sent you far and wide to the four winds of heaven, says the Lord.

verses.en: Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.
verses.pt: Ah! Escapai para Sião, vós que habitais com a filha de Babilônia.
verses.en_web: ‘Come, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.’
verses.en_bbe: Ho! Zion, go in flight from danger, you who are living with the daughter of Babylon.

verses.en: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.
verses.pt: Pois assim diz o Senhor dos exércitos: Para obter a glória ele me enviou às nações que vos despojaram; porque aquele que tocar em vós toca na menina do seu olho.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh of Armies says: ‘For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for he who touches you touches the apple of his eye.
verses.en_bbe: For this is what the Lord of armies has said: In the way of glory he has sent me to the nations which have taken your goods: for anyone touching you is touching what is most dear to him.

verses.en: For, behold, I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants: and ye shall know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me.
verses.pt: Porque eis aí levantarei a minha mão contra eles, e eles virão a ser a presa daqueles que os serviram; assim sabereis vós que o Senhor dos exércitos me enviou.
verses.en_web: For, behold, I will shake my hand over them, and they will be a plunder to those who served them; and you will know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me.
verses.en_bbe: For at the shaking of my hand over them, their goods will be taken by those who were their servants: and you will see that the Lord of armies has sent me.

verses.en: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: Exulta, e alegra-te, ó filha de Sião; pois eis que venho, e habitarei no meio de ti, diz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: Sing and rejoice, daughter of Zion; for, behold, I come, and I will dwell within you,’ says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Give songs of joy, O daughter of Zion: for I come, and I will make my resting-place among you, says the Lord.

verses.en: And many nations shall be joined to the LORD in that day, and shall be my people: and I will dwell in the midst of thee, and thou shalt know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto thee.
verses.pt: E naquele dia muitas nações se ajuntarão ao Senhor, e serão o meu povo; e habitarei no meio de ti, e saberás que o Senhor dos exércitos me enviou a ti.
verses.en_web: Many nations shall join themselves to Yahweh in that day, and shall be my people; and I will dwell among you, and you shall know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me to you.
verses.en_bbe: And a number of nations will be joined to the Lord in that day, and will become my people; and I will be living among you, and you will see that the Lord of armies has sent me to you.

verses.en: And the LORD shall inherit Judah his portion in the holy land, and shall choose Jerusalem again.
verses.pt: Então o Senhor possuirá a Judá como sua porção na terra santa, e ainda escolherá a Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and will again choose Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: And Judah will be the Lord's heritage in the holy land, and Jerusalem will again be his.

verses.en: Be silent, O all flesh, before the LORD: for he is raised up out of his holy habitation.
verses.pt: Cale-se, toda a carne, diante do Senhor; porque ele se levantou da sua santa morada.
verses.en_web: Be silent, all flesh, before Yahweh; for he has roused himself from his holy habitation!”
verses.en_bbe: Let all flesh be quiet and make no sound before the Lord: for he is awake and has come from his holy resting-place.
